active_work.title: Add left-button drag panning to canonical NEXOLAB charts

next_action: Exact head c758f7a6 preserved constant-span native pan and passed local/remote Core and Refrigeration gates, but Authenticated Dashboard still failed only the post-pan Exact Inspector resume assertion. A minimal Chromium experiment confirmed canceled pointermove still emits compatibility mousemove, while installed ECharts/ZRender code can stop descendant/native move propagation during renderer interaction. The new candidate makes only the canonical NEXOLAB Inspector mousemove listener capture-phase, retaining buttons-based drag suppression and lost-mouseup recovery, so post-release cursor inspection is independent of descendant bubble propagation. Regression coverage proves drag remains frozen and the first buttons=0 mousemove resumes onCursor even when a renderer child stops propagation. Local adapter tests 12/12, chart slice 60/60, touched ESLint, full TypeScript, Prettier, State Model and diff-check are GREEN. Commit/push and require exact-head Authenticated Dashboard, Core, Offline Bundle, Refrigeration Browser and Merge Gate GREEN before merge.
